data.exact_reserve_text: Within this profit, there was a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from 2013 year of account of GBP 13.3m before expenses and investment return. This arose largely from a reduction in the 2013 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2016.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in the 2013 and prior years' liability reserves leading to a profit on prior years (release)

named_events.loss_description: A medium sized event impacted the short tail account during 2016
Forest fires in Fort McMurray impacted the short tail account and contributed to deterioration
Flooding affected the short tail business and contributed to deterioration on the 2015 Account
Tornados impacted the short tail account during 2016

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net release of prior year reserves. The opening (1 Jan 2016) gross claims outstanding were GBP 245.893m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates an aggregate favourable movement on 2014-and-earlier underwriting years of approximately GBP 7.10m (release). Management attributes the primary cause of the release to favourable claims development and specific favourable settlements in 2016, in particular reducing 2013-and-prior liability reserves. Current year natural catastrophe activity (Hurricane Matthew, Fort McMurray fires, northern England flooding, US tornados) impacted the short-tail account but the prior-year reserve movement was dominated by favourable development on older liability claims.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial release of reserves from prior years of account now available due to the continuing favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account
reduction in the 2013 and prior years' liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2016

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (page 58) by comparing latest ultimates to the previous diagonal for UW years 2014 and older. A Reinsurance to Close (RITC) is present elsewhere in the disclosures (related to 2014 year closure) which can distort some movements; the triangle used appears to exclude an 'X and prior' aggregate column and is suitable. The LOB 'significant movements' breakdown available is presented net of reinsurance; where only net LOB movements exist those figures were used with lower confidence. The report contains both Underwriting Year Accounts and Annual Financial Statements; amounts used are from the Annual Financial Statements unless otherwise stated.
